title: Training return
sub: Higher is better. What training maximises. Only comparable within a run.

title: Team projectile hits per minute
sub: Wallcrawler team: accepted bullet impacts on the frozen opponents.

title: Predicted shot quality
sub: Mean launch-time interception quality, from 0 to 1. A shaping signal, not measured hits.

title: Targets cleared
sub: Share of practice trials in which every target was hit.

title: Team accuracy
sub: Accepted hits divided by actual crawler shots.

title: Stationary-target accuracy
sub: Accepted hits / shots in harmless stationary-target drills.

title: Moving-target accuracy
sub: Accepted hits / shots in harmless moving-target drills.

title: Battle curriculum stage
sub: 0: one Jelly; 1: two; 2: four; 3: four plus the armed hunter.

title: Battle survival
sub: Fraction of battle crawlers alive at trial end.

title: Combat accuracy
sub: Accepted hits / shots in retained Jellyfish and neural-hunter encounters.

title: Walking reversals per trial
sub: Actual direction changes while walking; stops and airborne motion excluded.

title: Voluntary jumps per trial
sub: Actual voluntary launches, excluding damage-induced detachment.

title: Bullet hits received per trial
sub: Average damaging bullet impacts received by the whole crawler team per trial. Lower is better.

title: Jellyfish contact hits per trial
sub: Average accepted damaging contacts received by crawlers; repeated overlap is limited by a shared cooldown.

title: Demonstration rehearsal loss
sub: Weighted auxiliary loss that helps retain demonstrated jump and landing choices. This is not an escape-success score.

title: Time airborne
sub: Share of crawler simulation time spent unattached, including stun and voluntary flight.

title: Crawler survival
sub: Share of the team still alive at trial end.

title: Speed
sub: Higher is better. Average speed as a share of top speed.

title: Powerups per episode
sub: Higher is better. Crystals the hunter collects.

title: Hunter power boost
sub: Share of time the generic power boost is active.

title: Deaths per episode
sub: Lower is better. Share of episodes in which the hunter is destroyed.

title: Follows the enemy compass
sub: Higher is better. Share of the time with no enemy in sight that the hunter heads within 45° of the compass.

title: Hits per episode
sub: Higher is better. Hunter shots that reach an enemy.

title: Unaimed shots per episode
sub: Shots not within 20° of an enemy in sight (at walls, at nothing, or well wide), each at the shot price.

title: Time in panic
sub: Share of decisions made in panic: after the last 5 s scored below the panic level, choices are more random until the score recovers.

title: Bored time
sub: Lower is better. Share of the time with no enemy in sight in which nothing new has come into view for a second: the same nearby walls (within 3 cells) and crystals as in the last 10 s.

title: Rules hunter beaten
sub: Higher is better. Share of Rules-hunter episodes in which it is destroyed.

title: Kills per minute
sub: Must not fall.

title: Wall collision quotient (per minute)
sub: Lower is better. Harder crashes count more.

title: Enemy hits taken per minute
sub: Lower is better.

title: Distance from the starting policy (KL)
sub: How far the policy has moved from where the run started.

title: Policy entropy
sub: Randomness of the controls. Near zero means it has stopped exploring.
